name: flown
description: Where you have flown: your KML flight logs as a static site.

paragraphs: Where you have flown: your KML flight logs as a static site.

Flown turns the KML flight logs of SkyDemon, Charterware and other aviation apps into a static site: a map of where the time was spent, with the flights coloured by altitude or groundspeed, the airports visited, statistics, replays, a 3D view and a year-in-review summary. The live demo shows the flights of this repository.

To see your own flights without setting anything up, open the live demo and drop your KML files on it: Your flights builds them in your browser, and they never leave it. To publish them the same way, fork this repository and follow Your own site on GitHub Pages; Adding flights takes each new flight from the export to the site.
